# Dr. Sanna Averbuch, ND

> Naturopathic doctor registered with the College of Naturopaths of Ontario, offering virtual naturopathic care by video to patients anywhere in Ontario, Canada. Special interest in fertility (individualized support for people trying to conceive, based on their cycle, health history and lab work), women's health, skin (acne, eczema, psoriasis), digestive health (bloating, IBS, GERD) and stress and chronic fatigue, and sees infants and children (booked directly with Dr. Averbuch, ND). New patients can book a 75-minute initial assessment directly or start with a free 15-minute virtual meet & greet, both booked online.

- Credentials: Doctor of Naturopathy (ND), Canadian College of Naturopathic Medicine (CCNM); BA Honours in Psychology, Wilfrid Laurier University
- Registration: in good standing with the College of Naturopaths of Ontario (CONO)
- Memberships: Ontario Association of Naturopathic Doctors (OAND); Canadian Association of Naturopathic Doctors (CAND)
- Clinical training: Reproductive Focus Shift; one-year internship at the Robert Schad Naturopathic Clinic
- Approach: root-cause, evidence-informed care combining clinical nutrition, supplementation, herbal medicine, acupuncture and lifestyle changes, with lab testing where indicated
- Book online: https://drsannaaverbuchnd.janeapp.com/
- Email: sanna.averbuch.nd@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cycleofbeauty/

## Visits and fees (CAD)

- [Meet & greet, 15 min, video](https://drsannaaverbuchnd.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1/treatment/2): Free
- [Initial assessment, 75 min, video, new patients](https://drsannaaverbuchnd.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1/treatment/1): $250
- [Extended follow-up, 60 min, video, existing patients](https://drsannaaverbuchnd.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1/treatment/3): $200
- [Follow-up, 45 min, video, existing patients](https://drsannaaverbuchnd.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1/treatment/4): $170
- [Short follow-up, 30 min, video, existing patients](https://drsannaaverbuchnd.janeapp.com/#/staff_member/1/treatment/5): $150
